Messages.Author: Justin Fang
Messages.Body:
This came up in a JOL game: I had the Curse of Nitocris. Another meth bled
his prey, ousting him and gaining the edge. I wanted to give the Curse to
the meth being ousted. Is this legal, or does the edge change possesion
after the ousted meth leaves the game? Thanks.

--
Justin Fang (jus...@ugcs.caltech.edu)
This space intentionally left blank.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
In article <6it4jr$2...@gap.cco.caltech.edu>,

jus...@ugcs.caltech.edu (Justin Fang) wrote:
>
> This came up in a JOL game: I had the Curse of Nitocris. Another meth bled
> his prey, ousting him and gaining the edge. I wanted to give the Curse to
> the meth being ousted. Is this legal, or does the edge change possesion
> after the ousted meth leaves the game? Thanks.

It is not legal. The Edge changes hands when the pool is burned (so it
changes at the same time as the ousted Meth leaves), but the Curse
cannot be transferred until the Edge changes hands, which is immediately
after this point (and therefore not until the ousted Meth is really
ousted).

--
